description: I’m a mom, a wife, a leader in corporate America, and an involved community member. So why add one more thing to my plate and run for office? I’m running because I’m also the daughter of two Air Force Veterans and the survivor of a school shooting. I’m running because I navigated the 2008 recession as a college graduate, got married during the COVID pandemic, and had children in a state where I had no guarantee that I would receive the healthcare I needed during pregnancy.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Racheal for Indiana
